_note: Source discipline: every kaiju carries its own provenance. verified=true means a current-era source (badge API / live Fandom page / named creator on camera) confirms it exists in-game NOW. Stale-tier fields (tier/price from kaijualpha.com's Update 24-39 era) are kept as historical reference with staleTier/stalePrice and must NOT be rendered as current meta. Roster scale: 53+ kaiju as of 2026-06-24 per Tycooner's all-kaiju template; badge API = 11 max-progression badges as of 2026-09-28. Codes: cross-source pass 2026-10-17 (Beebom / UrGameTips / GachaPocket + creator videos) — 'active' needs 2 independent sources listing it as working; old kaijualpha.com codes stay single-source and flagged.

systems.name: G-cells (currency)
systems.detail: Earned by damaging other players — assists pay in full, so reach matters more than kills (Tycooner/Mon Crex, recorded play). Endgame kaiju priced 200,000-500,000 G-cells in the Update 21-32 era; current prices unverified.

systems.name: Leveling & EXP
systems.detail: Kaiju level to 200+ (creator videos show Level 200+ gameplay). Fandom has a Leveling & EXP page. Exact curve unpublished by any named source.

systems.name: Skill bar
systems.detail: Ultima's kit: attacks over 100 bar heal / increase hitbox; full bar utility transforms. Per-game mechanic, likely shared shape across kaiju — confirm per-kaiju in-game.

systems.name: Skill Points
systems.detail: Fandom page exists; allocation rules unpublished by named sources.

systems.name: Archetype spawns
systems.detail: Every 30 minutes incl. private servers (Update 51 description). Details thin — high-value gap for a dedicated page.

systems.name: Evolutions / forms
systems.detail: Multiple kaiju have form lines (Destoroyah Aggregate→Flying→Final; Mothra Larva→Imago). 'EVOLVED GODZILLA REQUIREMENTS' is a real search query with no good text answer.

systems.name: Objective unlocks
systems.detail: Monster Zero unlocks via skull collection (count unverified — AI wikis only per kaijualpha.com); locations guide exists from ItzVexo.

systems.name: Catastrophe Gauge
systems.detail: HUD meter (x/200) that charges in combat — full mechanic unpublished; Ultima's V move (Archetype Interitus/Ultima Finis) likely interacts with it.

systems.name: Maps
systems.detail: Confirmed playable: TOKYO (city + bay) and DESERT. MAP screen offers region select with SPAWN.

systems.name: Shop (Robux)
systems.detail: Starter Pack R$99 (key shard + aura + 9,000 Cells); Pacific Rim #1 R$749 (2 kaiju + 30,000 Cells). Robux→Cells: 145=25K, 290=50K, 580=100K, 1,720=300K. Read from in-game shop UI on creator footage.

systems.name: Skill Points
systems.detail: Level cap 200 ('MAXED' tag at 200). Points allocate into Energy/Health/Regen/Speed/Strength tracks; damage numbers scale per point (frame-read progression: Morsus Singularis 190→670→875).
